notes: 2026-09-10 fact pass. Address confirmed on the church's own homepage: 955 N 10th Ave, Tucson, AZ 85705-7623 (recorded as 85705 for the five-digit field); phone 520-622-2218. Geocode left 'missing' so tools/geocode.py fills it. Pastor Jonathan Smith, MPH, MA is named on the homepage and has his own 'Our Pastor' page; he is the only pastor listed, and his email (pastorjs1896@gmail.com) is the church contact. YouTube channel confirmed as @tucsonsharonchurch (channel id UC6k7FD-AGMnUn-kvBG6RgOg) - the church's own homepage embeds a video from that channel. Both a Videos tab (titled expository messages, e.g. 'Can You Hear God's Voice? Learning to Listen (Hebrews 1:1-2)') and a Live tab ('Tucson Sharon Worship Experience' full services) carry sermon material, so a corpus is obtainable. Beware of a lookalike handle @tucsonsharonsdachurch and an old 'Sharon SDAChurch' channel (UCevrerT4p9j2A0wL8pjOD5g) that surface in search but are not the channel the church itself links to. Worship is Saturday at 12:00 PM MST with Bible study at 10:30 AM. Historically Black Adventist congregation in Tucson.
